papers.title: Longest common subsequences of two random sequences
papers.abstract: First proved existence of the limiting constant gamma_k for the expected LCS length of two random sequences.

papers.title: Expected length of longest common subsequences
papers.abstract: Developed DFA-based Markov chain method for lower bounds. Achieved 0.773911 for binary alphabet.

papers.title: Upper Bounds for the Expected Length of a Longest Common Subsequence of Two Binary Sequences
papers.abstract: Established the 0.837623 upper bound for binary LCS using automata-based dual method.

papers.title: Improved bounds on the average length of longest common subsequences
papers.abstract: Developed the feasible-triplet framework yielding both improved lower (0.788071) and upper (0.826280) bounds for binary alphabet.

papers.title: Improved Lower Bounds on the Expected Length of Longest Common Subsequences
papers.abstract: Obtained new best lower bound of 0.792665992 for sigma=2, d=2 through parallelization and memory optimization of previous algorithms.

papers.title: The Chvátal-Sankoff problem: Understanding random string comparison through stochastic processes
papers.abstract: Linked the Chvátal-Sankoff constant to parameters of a stochastic particle process. Obtained a new estimate for gamma.

papers.title: Periodic words, common subsequences and frogs
papers.abstract: Introduced frog dynamics for periodic-vs-random LCS. Showed expectation is gamma_W*n - O(sqrt(n)) for efficiently computable gamma_W.

papers.title: Frogs, hats and common subsequences
papers.abstract: Extended Bukh-Cox frog dynamics to palindromic words. Analyzed PushTASEP with correlated clocks.

papers.title: On a Speculated Relation Between Chvátal-Sankoff Constants of Several Sequences
papers.abstract: Disproved a speculation by Steele regarding gamma_{2,d} and gamma_{2,2}. Obtained new lower bounds for small sigma and d.

papers.title: Expected Length of the Longest Common Subsequence for Large Alphabets
papers.abstract: Proved Sankoff-Mainville conjecture: gamma_k * sqrt(k) -> 2 as k -> infinity.

papers.title: High precision simulations of the longest common subsequence problem
papers.abstract: Multi-spin coding MC simulation yielding high-precision estimate gamma_2 ≈ 0.8117. Established finite-size scaling form.

papers.title: Standard deviation of the longest common subsequence
papers.abstract: Proved the order of the standard deviation of L_n is sqrt(n) for small enough Bernoulli parameter.

papers.title: Capacity Upper Bounds for Deletion-type Channels
papers.abstract: Systematic approach for capacity upper bounds for binary deletion and repetition channels. For d=1/2: capacity at most (1-d)*log(phi).

papers.title: Improved Upper and Lower Bounds on the Capacity of the Binary Deletion Channel
papers.abstract: Improved deletion channel capacity bounds using Blahut-Arimoto with lower space complexity.

papers.title: Upper bounds on the average edit distance between two random strings
papers.abstract: Adapted Lueker technique to improve upper bounds on average edit distance. Also improved LCS lower bounds for small alphabets (not sigma=2).

papers.title: Longest common subsequences in binary sequences
papers.abstract: Studied E[L(nz,n)]/n for unequal length strings and its relation to the Chvátal-Sankoff constant.

papers.title: Expected Length of the Longest Common Subsequence of Multiple Strings
papers.abstract: Derived asymptotically tight bounds for gamma_{2,d}: gamma_{2,d} = 1/2 + Theta(1/sqrt(d)).

papers.title: On the Convergence of Upper Bound Techniques for the Average Length of Longest Common Subsequences
papers.venue: Workshop on Analytic Algorithmics and Combinatorics (ANALCO)
papers.abstract: Analysis of convergence properties of upper bound techniques for the LCS problem.

papers.title: Scale Invariance of the PNG Droplet and the Airy Process
papers.abstract: Established the Airy process as the limit of PNG droplet. Connection to LIS/LCS through Tracy-Widom distribution.

papers.title: On the distribution of the length of the second row of a Young diagram under Plancherel measure
papers.abstract: Proved Tracy-Widom fluctuations for longest increasing subsequence of random permutations.

papers.title: Colored interacting particle systems on the ring: Stationary measures from Yang-Baxter equations
papers.abstract: Unified approach to stationary measures for colored particle systems including PushTASEP (related to Bukh-Cox frog dynamics).

papers.title: The length of the longest common subsequence of two independent Mallows permutations
papers.abstract: Studied LCS of Mallows permutations, connecting to random matrix theory.

papers.title: Improved Approximation for Longest Common Subsequence over Small Alphabets
papers.abstract: Showed the binary case is hardest for subquadratic LCS approximation algorithms.

papers.title: Reducing approximate Longest Common Subsequence to approximate Edit Distance
papers.abstract: First efficient (1/2+epsilon)-approximation for binary LCS in truly subquadratic time.

papers.title: Capacity upper bounds for deletion-type channels
papers.abstract: Showed capacity of binary deletion channel with d>=1/2 is at most (1-d)*log(phi). Systematic convex programming approach.

papers.title: Improved Capacity Upper Bounds for the Discrete-Time Poisson Channel
papers.abstract: Extended deletion channel techniques to Poisson channel. Techniques may apply to LCS upper bounds.

papers.title: Fluctuation of the Length of the Longest Common Subsequence
papers.abstract: Early work on LCS fluctuations connecting to variance bounds.

papers.title: Longest Increasing Subsequences of Random Colored Permutations
papers.abstract: LIS of colored permutations has Tracy-Widom limit. Connects to multi-alphabet LCS.

papers.title: Large deviations of geodesic midpoint fluctuations in last-passage percolation with general i.i.d. weights
papers.abstract: LDP for midpoint fluctuations in general LPP models. Relevant to understanding LCS path structure.

papers.title: Optimal tail estimates in beta-ensembles and applications to last passage percolation
papers.abstract: Sharp moderate deviation estimates for Tracy-Widom distribution with LPP applications.

papers.title: Time-time Covariance for Last Passage Percolation with Generic Initial Profile
papers.abstract: Time correlation for KPZ growth. Relevant to finite-size scaling of LCS.

papers.title: Diffusive scaling limit of the Busemann process in last passage percolation
papers.abstract: Scaling limit of Busemann process in exponential LPP. Connection to KPZ fixed point.

papers.title: The stationary horizon as the central multi-type invariant measure in the KPZ universality class
papers.abstract: Constructed the stationary horizon as scaling limit of Busemann process. Describes semi-infinite geodesics in the directed landscape.

papers.title: An improvement of the deletion channel capacity upper bound
papers.abstract: Improved deletion channel capacity upper bound using Blahut-Arimoto algorithm. Relevant to potential LCS upper bounds.

papers.title: New Capacity Upper Bounds For Binary Deletion Channel
papers.abstract: New close form upper bounds on deletion channel capacity using auxiliary channel and mutual information approximation.
